coverage.description: Integer literals/variables are reduced modulo P61. Negation and add/sub/mul combine residues. Power evaluates exponent exactly in a fresh Env cloned from vars, rejects negative/noninteger exponents, then square-and-multiplies over exponent bits. Factorial uses the operand residue as its argument and rejects residue>2M.
